title: True Fasting

questions.question: Cry aloud; do not hold back; lift up your voice like a trumpet; declare to my people their transgression, to the house of Jacob their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:1 (ESV): "to the house of Jacob their sins."

questions.question: Yet they seek me daily and delight to know my ways, as if they were a nation that did righteousness and did not forsake the judgment of their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:2 (ESV): "did not forsake the judgment of their God;"

questions.question: Is not this the fast that I choose: to loose the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and to break every what?
Is it not to share your bread with the hungry and bring the homeless poor into your house; when you see the naked, to cover him, and not to hide yourself from your own what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:7 (ESV): "not to hide yourself from your own flesh?"

questions.question: Then shall your light break forth like the dawn, and your healing shall spring up speedily; your righteousness shall go before you; the glory of the LORD shall be your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:8 (ESV): "the glory of the LORD shall be your rear guard."

questions.question: Then you shall call, and the LORD will answer; you shall cry, and he will say, 'Here I am.' If you take away the yoke from your midst, the pointing of the finger, and speaking what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:9 (ESV): "the pointing of the finger, and speaking wickedness,"

questions.question: If you pour yourself out for the hungry and satisfy the desire of the afflicted, then shall your light rise in the darkness and your gloom be as the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:10 (ESV): "and your gloom be as the noonday."

questions.question: And the LORD will guide you continually and satisfy your desire in scorched places and make your bones strong; and you shall be like a watered what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:11 (ESV): "you shall be like a watered garden,"

questions.question: And your ancient ruins shall be rebuilt; you shall raise up the foundations of many generations; you shall be called the repairer of the breach, the restorer of streets to what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:12 (ESV): "the restorer of streets to dwell in."

questions.question: If you turn back your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day, and call the Sabbath a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:13 (ESV): "and call the Sabbath a delight,"

questions.question: And the holy day of the LORD honorable; if you honor it, not going your own ways, or seeking your own pleasure, or talking what?
Then you shall take delight in the LORD, and I will make you ride on the heights of the earth; I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father, for the mouth of the LORD has what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:14 (ESV): "for the mouth of the LORD has spoken."

questions.question: Behold, in the day of your fast you seek your own pleasure, and oppress all your what?
Behold, you fast only to quarrel and to fight and to hit with a wicked what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:4 (ESV): "and to hit with a wicked fist."

questions.question: Is such the fast that I choose, a day for a man to humble himself? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and what under him?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 58:5 (ESV): "and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him?"

key_verse_text: Is not this the fast that I choose: to loose the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and to break every yoke?
